zh.title: 國防部：偵獲8艘共艦9艘公務船，嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部公佈共機艦動態；偵獲8艘共艦、9艘公務船
body: 國防部發布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲8艘共艦、9艘公務船，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
國防部上午公佈共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲8艘共艦、9艘公務船持續在臺海周邊活動。期間並無偵獲共機。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan defense ministry: 8 PLA warships, 9 official vessels tracked near Taiwan
en.summary: MND logs 8 PLA ships, 9 official vessels near Taiwan; no aircraft detected
body: The Ministry of National Defense released its latest Chinese aircraft and vessel activity update, recording that from 6 a.m. yesterday to 6 a.m. today, 8 Chinese military vessels and 9 official vessels were detected. The armed forces used mission aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems to monitor and respond.

The defense ministry announced the activity update in the morning, noting that 8 Chinese warships and 9 official vessels continued to operate in the waters around the Taiwan Strait from 6 a.m. yesterday to 6 a.m. today. No Chinese aircraft were detected during the period.
The ministry emphasized that the armed forces used mission aircraft, vessels, and shore-based missile systems to tightly monitor and respond.
